mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when this trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the same month signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < previous month - 10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) decline of more than 1% from the previous month, sustained for two consecutive months, signals a contraction in economic output, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month - 1% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in CPIAUCSL below 2% while FEDFUNDS remains below 1% for three consecutive months signals a deflationary bias with accommodative policy, which lowers long-term real interest rates and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2% AND FEDFUNDS < 1% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not statistically greater than zero (t-test p > 0.05) during triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) combined with a concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% signals strengthening household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month + 0.5% AND HOUST > previous month + 5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero (t-test p > 0.10) in triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% for four consecutive months, without a corresponding rise in wage inflation proxies (not available here), indicates a tight labor market that may precede wage pressure, but in the absence of wage data, this alone does not guarantee negative returns; however, if consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) does not accelerate, the effect is muted, resulting in no consistent S&P 500 return direction over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% for four consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL growth < 0.2% month-over-month
regime_hint: tight labor market with low inflation
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns show no statistically significant deviation from zero (t-test p > 0.20) during triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of at least 0.5% for four consecutive months signals a broad-based expansion in supply capacity, which typically supports corporate earnings and justifies positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > previous month + 0.5% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly above zero (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered episodes.
